### Create Design Kit
POST /brand-boards/locations/{locationId}/design-kits
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/brand-boards/locations/{locationId}/design-kits
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/brand-boards/create-design-kit | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/brand-boards/create-design-kit.md

Create a design kit for a location

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: brand-boards/design-kit.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "oHJiAh0wDG3BzmzACVD6") - ID of the location where the design kit will be created.

Request body (required) (application/json) CreateDesignKitPublicV3BodyDto:
- name string (e.g. "My Design Kit") - Display name for the design kit.
- logos object[] - Logos to include in the design kit.
  - id string (e.g. "6a1d1e5db5ef0dfa799ed3c9") - Identifier of an existing logo. Include it to update the same logo; omit it to add a new one.
  - url* string (e.g. "https://storage.googleapis.com/bucket/logos/my-logo.png") - Publicly accessible URL of the logo image.
  - label* string (e.g. "Primary Logo") - Display name for the logo.
- colors object[] - Colors to include in the design kit.
  - id string (e.g. "6a1d1e5db5ef0dfa799ed3c9") - Identifier of an existing color. Include it to update the same color; omit it to add a new one.
  - value* string (e.g. "#FF5733") - Hex color value. Accepts 3, 4, 6, or 8 hex digits with an optional leading `#`. The 4- and 8-digit forms include an alpha channel (e.g. `#F00F`, `#FF5733FF`). When updating an existing color, copy the `hexa` field from a previous response to keep the alpha channel — using `hex` will drop the alpha.
  - label* string (e.g. "Brand Orange") - Display name for the color.
- fonts object[] - Fonts to include in the design kit.
  - id string (e.g. "6a1d1e5db5ef0dfa799ed3c9") - Identifier of an existing font. Include it to update the same font; omit it to add a new one.
  - font* string (e.g. "Montserrat") - Primary font family name.
  - fallback* string (e.g. "sans-serif") - Fallback font family used when the primary is unavailable.
  - label* string (e.g. "Heading Font") - Display name for the font.
- type string (enum: blank | url; e.g. "blank") - How the design kit should be initialized. Use `blank` for an empty kit, or `url` to extract branding from a website (requires `url`).
- url string (e.g. "https://example.com") - Website URL to extract branding from. Required when `type` is `url`.

Response 201 (Created) application/json:
- id* string - Unique identifier of the design kit.
- name* string - Display name of the design kit.
- isDefault* boolean - Whether this is the default design kit for the location.
- createdAt* string - ISO 8601 timestamp of when the design kit was created.
- updatedAt* string - ISO 8601 timestamp of when the design kit was last updated.
- locationId* string - ID of the location that owns the design kit.
- deleted* boolean - Whether the design kit has been soft-deleted.
- logos object[] - Logos belonging to the design kit.
  - id string - Identifier of an existing logo. Include it to update the same logo; omit it to add a new one.
  - url* string - Publicly accessible URL of the logo image.
  - label* string - Display name for the logo.
- colors object[] - Colors belonging to the design kit.
  - id string - Unique identifier of the color.
  - hex* string - 6-digit hex representation of the color, without alpha.
  - hexa* string - 8-digit hex representation of the color, including the alpha channel.
  - rgb* string - RGB representation of the color.
  - rgba* string - RGBA representation of the color, including the alpha channel.
  - label* string - Display name for the color.
- fonts object[] - Fonts belonging to the design kit.
  - id string - Identifier of an existing font. Include it to update the same font; omit it to add a new one.
  - font* string - Primary font family name.
  - fallback* string - Fallback font family used when the primary is unavailable.
  - label* string - Display name for the font.
- traceId string - Trace identifier for the request, useful for debugging and support.

  - id string (e.g. "6a1d1e5db5ef0dfa799ed3c9") - Identifier of an existing logo. Include it to update the same logo; omit it to add a new one.
  - url* string (e.g. "https://storage.googleapis.com/bucket/logos/my-logo.png") - Publicly accessible URL of the logo image.
  - label* string (e.g. "Primary Logo") - Display name for the logo.
- colors object[] - Colors for the design kit. Sending this field replaces the existing colors. To keep an existing color, include it with its `id`.
  - id string (e.g. "6a1d1e5db5ef0dfa799ed3c9") - Identifier of an existing color. Include it to update the same color; omit it to add a new one.
  - value* string (e.g. "#FF5733") - Hex color value. Accepts 3, 4, 6, or 8 hex digits with an optional leading `#`. The 4- and 8-digit forms include an alpha channel (e.g. `#F00F`, `#FF5733FF`). When updating an existing color, copy the `hexa` field from a previous response to keep the alpha channel — using `hex` will drop the alpha.
  - label* string (e.g. "Brand Orange") - Display name for the color.
- fonts object[] - Fonts for the design kit. Sending this field replaces the existing fonts. To keep an existing font, include it with its `id`.
  - id string (e.g. "6a1d1e5db5ef0dfa799ed3c9") - Identifier of an existing font. Include it to update the same font; omit it to add a new one.
  - font* string (e.g. "Montserrat") - Primary font family name.
  - fallback* string (e.g. "sans-serif") - Fallback font family used when the primary is unavailable.
  - label* string (e.g. "Heading Font") - Display name for the font.

Response 200 (Success) application/json:
- id* string - Unique identifier of the design kit.
- name* string - Display name of the design kit.
- isDefault* boolean - Whether this is the default design kit for the location.
- createdAt* string - ISO 8601 timestamp of when the design kit was created.
- updatedAt* string - ISO 8601 timestamp of when the design kit was last updated.
- locationId* string - ID of the location that owns the design kit.
- deleted* boolean - Whether the design kit has been soft-deleted.
- logos object[] - Logos belonging to the design kit.
  - id string - Identifier of an existing logo. Include it to update the same logo; omit it to add a new one.
  - url* string - Publicly accessible URL of the logo image.
  - label* string - Display name for the logo.
- colors object[] - Colors belonging to the design kit.
  - id string - Unique identifier of the color.
  - hex* string - 6-digit hex representation of the color, without alpha.
  - hexa* string - 8-digit hex representation of the color, including the alpha channel.
  - rgb* string - RGB representation of the color.
  - rgba* string - RGBA representation of the color, including the alpha channel.
  - label* string - Display name for the color.
- fonts object[] - Fonts belonging to the design kit.
  - id string - Identifier of an existing font. Include it to update the same font; omit it to add a new one.
  - font* string - Primary font family name.
  - fallback* string - Fallback font family used when the primary is unavailable.
  - label* string - Display name for the font.
- traceId string - Trace identifier for the request, useful for debugging and support.

Errors: 400, 401, 403, 404, 422 (400, 401, 403, 422: see Common error responses)
Response 404 (Not Found) application/json:
- statusCode number - HTTP status code for not found
- message string - Error message describing the not found failure
- error string - Error type identifier
